name: HoneycombLens
job: Lay out many photos as a honeycomb where cells near the pointer swell like a fisheye lens while the rest recede
visitor_action: hover/drag across the grid; tap a cell to open it; arrow keys move between photos, Enter opens one
mobile: lens pile wraps to 2–3 columns with the hero lens always fully in frame; drag to magnify, tap opens
motion: lenses spring-drop onto the black glass floor in a stagger, then a light sweep flares across them as photos fade in; the pointer lens carries real spring physics — nearby lenses magnify their photo through refraction, push apart and brighten their chromatic rims; speculars slide with the pointer; caption follows the active lens (reduced-motion: settled static pile, direct state changes, no springs)

checks.render: pass (CDP device-emulation shots; 375 fixed: single instance, hero in frame, no top/left clip; no console errors or vite overlay)
checks.craft: pass (3, after 1 polish pass: glass edges amplified to read at 2x)

art_direction: Macro lens: black glass ground, hexagonal photo lenses piled with overlap and a 2x hero lens off-centre-left, real refraction (strip-based barrel magnification), warm/cool chromatic edge fringes, sliding speculars and a floor reflection; the comb bleeds off the right edge
